classification: Standalone C# observational trace; no combat or purchase changes
observationNotes: Contact prediction uses existing enemy position <=12+speed/30 before Tick and is asserted against actual leak-count delta every tick. Spawned enemies start at360 and cannot contact in the spawn tick.
Contact state is before Tick and its scheduled purchase; hpAfter is actual end of movement phase shared by simultaneous contacts.
Lifetime firstSeen is one sampled tick after spawn; inRangeTicks measures geometric coverage, not weapon readiness or target selection.
Attack count tracks direct AttackEvent only, excludes field damage. hpRemaining captures all actual damage.
No candidate tuning or causal intervention performed.
